# generated by make-kit.sh trace from strace logs of the real build steps; kind paths are relative to the VitaSDK root.
# prog = executable (".exe" is added on Windows), lib = shared library or plugin (.so / .dll / .dylib), data = read by a host program.
# Not needed (never opened): cc1, bin/arm-vita-eabi-ld, vita-mksfoex, vita-pack-vpk, psp2rela, gdb, lto-dump, objdump, strip, ranlib.
prog arm-vita-eabi/bin/ar   # archive tool run by gcc-ar
prog arm-vita-eabi/bin/as   # the assembler gcc runs on the code lto1 writes
prog arm-vita-eabi/bin/ld   # the linker (collect2 runs this one, not bin/arm-vita-eabi-ld)
prog bin/arm-vita-eabi-g++   # the compiler driver: compiles, and links (runs collect2, lto-wrapper, ld)
prog bin/arm-vita-eabi-gcc-ar   # archive step: ar with the LTO plugin
prog bin/arm-vita-eabi-nm   # post-link check for weak pthread functions
prog bin/arm-vita-eabi-readelf   # measures the room after the code segment (text pad check)
prog bin/vita-elf-create   # ELF -> Sony ELF (imports/exports from the stub libraries)
prog bin/vita-make-fself   # Sony ELF -> eboot.bin
prog lib/gcc/arm-vita-eabi/15.2.0/cc1plus   # the C++ compiler proper (compiling the 74 generated units)
prog lib/gcc/arm-vita-eabi/15.2.0/collect2   # the link driver gcc calls instead of ld
prog lib/gcc/arm-vita-eabi/15.2.0/lto-wrapper   # runs lto1 for the link (and `make`, when there is one, to run partitions in parallel)
prog lib/gcc/arm-vita-eabi/15.2.0/lto1   # the link-time optimiser (whole-program analysis and the partitions)
lib lib/bfd-plugins/libdep   # loaded by ar together with the plugin above
lib lib/bfd-plugins/liblto_plugin   # the plugin ar loads to index LTO objects
lib lib/gcc/arm-vita-eabi/15.2.0/liblto_plugin   # the linker plugin that hands the LTO objects to lto-wrapper
